name: just-screenshotter
description: A screenshot tool with zero idle load

scripts.rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets --locked && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked -p screenshotter-capture -p screenshotter-film -p screenshotter-keys -p screenshotter-mouse -p screenshotter-phrase -p screenshotter-store -p screenshotter-upload
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run types && npm test && npm run bundle && npm run extension && npm run licenses && npm run rust
